properties.description: Both the fifteen skills and the ~20 KB instruction document are compiled in at build time (build.rs embeds getting-started/), served by list_skills, get_skill and get_instructions, and advertised by a catalogue plus a call-get_instructions-first line in the server instructions — the one channel a client puts in the agent's context unasked. What an install leaves in a project is a 2.4 KB pointer file naming those three tools, the MCP configs, .reflow2/ and a gitignore line; nothing else, and nothing that a later release rewrites. The installer removes the skill copies an older kit left: untouched ones deleted with the reason, edited ones kept and reported as SHADOWING the served skill, because a harness does auto-load those.
properties.name: Serve the skills AND the working instructions from the binary, so a project holds only a pointer
